summary.text: Daryl Abbas is a Republican state senator and attorney from Salem, New Hampshire, who has represented District 22 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Abbas lives in Salem, New Hampshire, and graduated from Salem High School in 2002. He earned a B.A. in political science and a J.D. from Suffolk University in 2006 and 2009, respectively.

His career experience includes working as a partner with the Upper Charles Law Group, LLC, the principal attorney of The Law Office of Daryl Abbas, and a litigation associate with Lustig, Glaser, & Wilson, P.C.
Abbas served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 8 from 2018 to 2022 and assumed office in the State Senate on December 7, 2022.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Children and Family Law Committee, is vice chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee, and serves on the Senate Education Committee.
